[LCCO.5.6] If no continuation references any LHS binding, the
capture fact carries no snapshot slots. For a call whose correlation is
generated or computed, the compiler must still emit it, with the `corr` slot
alone, because it is what carries the correlation to the siblings; only for a
call whose `as` is a compile-time constant may the compiler omit it
([LCCO.5.2]).
